留空表示个人账本全部账户；任务仍受分项隐私授权限制。: Leave empty for all personal accounts. Individual privacy permissions still apply.
本次授权仅适用于当前计划摘要，30分钟后到期。请核对每项影响与原值。: This authorization covers only the current plan hash and expires in 30 minutes. Review every change and original value.
仅执行当前展示并确认的计划；后续新增操作会重新检查授权。: Execute only the displayed plan. Any additional operations will undergo a new authorization check.
请先开启AI并授权保存历史: Enable AI and authorize history storage first
持久任务会保存描述、完整计划、结果与日志，请在隐私设置中授权。: Persistent tasks store descriptions, complete plans, results and logs. Authorize this in privacy settings.
复杂任务与多轮执行: Complex tasks and multiple tool rounds
例如：对比过去三年各账户支出，找出异常商户，准备分类和预算调整方案，并保存报告。: Example: Compare account spending over three years, identify unusual merchants, prepare classification and budget changes, and save a report.
已逐项核对完整操作计划、影响范围及原值: I have reviewed every operation, its scope and original values
单独授权本次高风险计划，不授予长期高风险权限: Authorize this high-risk plan separately, without persistent high-risk permissions
授权并执行本次高风险计划: Authorize and execute this high-risk plan
预算由后端校验，不能超过注册模型容量与服务器资源上限。: The server validates budgets against registered model capacities and server resource limits.
自动模式仅执行有效授权覆盖的操作。预算不足、授权撤销或版本变化会阻止执行；长期授: Auto mode executes operations covered by valid grants. Insufficient budgets, revoked permissions or changed versions block execution. Authorized low-risk operations need no repeated confirmation.
允许传输名称、商户和备注: Allow names, merchants and notes to be transmitted
商户关联和自然语言分类需要这些描述；默认仅传匿名ID、金额与状态。: Merchant analysis and natural-language classification need descriptions. By default, only anonymous IDs, amounts and status are transmitted.
费用为服务端费率估算；缺少费率或用量不明时不会按零费用处理。设置费用预算前须由管: Costs are estimated using server rates. Missing rates or unknown usage are never treated as zero. An administrator must configure valid rates before a cost budget can be enforced.
查看模型用量与费用记录: View model usage and cost records
按操作类型、账户范围与期限授权: Authorize operation types, accounts and expiry
批量删除等高风险操作不能使用普通长期授权。: High-risk operations, including batch deletion, require separate authorization for a specific plan.
独立保存、可编辑和删除的授权记忆: Authorized memories you can edit and delete
按资源与成本预算控制: Controlled by resource and cost budgets
服务端 AI 未启用或未配置模型密钥: Server AI is disabled or the model API key is not configured
长期图表已采样，完整收支、期末和最低余额仍精确计算；缺口日期列表为展示样本。: The long-term chart is sampled. Totals, closing balance and minimum balance use all events. Listed shortfall dates are display samples.
